info.intro: Sæludagar are a few days in the school year when attendance is optional. The school runs events, and students sign up for the ones they want.

steps.login: You get a 6-digit code by email and log in with your kennitala and the code. If you lose the code, you can get a new one on the login page.
steps.signup: While sign-up is open, you sign up for up to {max} events, with at most {perDay} on one day. The events must not overlap in time, and some are only for students of certain brautir.
steps.cancel: While sign-up is open you can also cancel, and the place becomes free straight away.
steps.attend: You go to the event, and the Event Manager records your attendance.
steps.choose: Once your attendance is recorded, you give the absence points to a course on the "Absence points" page. You can change this until the deadline above.

info.points: Each attendance at an event counts as {points} points in one course. At most {perCourse} points can be removed per course, in up to {max} courses ({total} points in total).
info.pointsOffice: The site does not keep track of absence points itself. The school office enters the deductions into Inna after the deadline.
info.contactPlaceholder: Who to contact with questions will be added here once the school has sent it.
